meta.title: Watchlist autobet control plane (paper only)
meta.description: Paper-only watchlist autobet control plane for sportsdesk-ops: nine Host tools (status, signals, plan, queue, journal, and confirm-gated enqueue/approve/reject/paper execute/settle) plus a Web UI operator page with an approval queue, decision tracking, per-intent context and a Signals inspector that shows every gate check. It manages the human in the loop and records decisions in the append-only paper ledger. Live betting is not implemented and no live order path exists.
